title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Collections Schedule: Default Threshold, Cure Scope and Recovery Fee
content:
# Collections Schedule — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

The commercial collections figures of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, by program tier.

## Default threshold

The default threshold is the days an invoice may remain unpaid before the unit schedule is declared in default.

| Program tier | Days past due before default may be declared |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | 45 |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | 45 |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | 60 |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | 60 |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | 75 |
| Kestrel National Fleet | 90 |

## Cure scope and recovery fee (every tier)

| Item | Every program tier |
|---|---|
| Curing a default requires every past-due invoice on the master agreement to be paid | Yes |
| Fee charged when a unit is recovered after default | 525 USD |

## Points of reference

- The threshold rises with the tier: 45 days in the two entry tiers, 60 in Kestrel Fleet Preferred and Kestrel Fleet Premier, 75 in Kestrel Fleet Enterprise and 90 in Kestrel National Fleet.
- The cure scope is the whole master agreement in every tier, not the single unit in default.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Fleet Enterprise unit with an invoice 74 days past due is below its 75-day threshold; at 75 days it reaches the threshold.
